usedFor: Chatrace keeps chat contacts organised, with “Create Contact”, “Create Tag” and “Create Custom Fields” as its steps.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking Created” in Recras, then “Create Custom Fields” in Chatrace
bestTemplate.why: A new booking brings details worth keeping, and the action adds a field for them.

watchOut: “Create Contact” and “Create Tag” both write to Chatrace, so test with one event before a busy trigger runs them.
